name: Cloud Native EHR Platform
objective: Build a scalable, HIPAA-compliant healthcare data exchange platform processing HL7/FHIR clinical records with real-time audit logging and role-based physician access.
context: Enterprise regional hospital network serving 500,000 patients with strict regulatory privacy constraints.
constraints: HIPAA Title II compliance with cryptographic audit trail
Must run on Kubernetes containerized cloud infrastructure
P99 query response latency under 200ms for emergency room vitals
